state:
Milestone `dossier`, goal `the-description-is-owed`, stage 2. `data/proofs/policy.json` carries
`owes.all.about: true`, so `bun nv proofs --gate` counts a missing or misshapen `about.md`. It names
80 of 1159 features: 46 tool sections with no description, 21 descriptions over 200 words (3 types,
8 language sections, 10 directives), and 13 features that owe more than a description. No `Core`
member is in that list any more.

**The chain order cannot reach this goal as it stands.** Its check is the whole roster, and the 13
features are the 5 of `tools:install` and 8 of `tools:server`, which owe a test, an example and an
attack as well. Goals `tools-install` and `tools-server` own those and sit behind this goal on the
chain, and only the driver moves `live`. Nothing is blocked until every other description is written.
The closed goals' group checks (`bun nv proofs --verify --group <G>`) are red for every group that
still has a feature in the list above; that is this goal's work and not a regression.

**One call made for the user, to look at.** Gap `nvs-ir/throws-on-an-array-key-that` named goal
`coalesce-assign` as its owner, and `bun nv owners --check` refuses every goal-owned gap, so
`bun nv verify` stopped at its `owners` step in every session. The record is back at
`milestone: M10`, and `docs/agent/goals/coalesce-assign.md` still has that goal delete it. If the
owner gate is meant to hold that goal open, `tools/nv/cmd/owners.ts:79` is what has to accept it.

The pack does not print `docs/examples/README.md` § *The description*; it is one `bun nv peek`.
A group is checked with `bun nv proofs --gate --group '<G>'`; `--only` takes feature ids alone.

**The ten directive descriptions over 200 words are rewritten** (`rule:testing/feature-proofs`): `docs/examples/config/limits-fatal_reserve_memory/about.md:1`, `docs/examples/config/limits-fatal_reserve_time/about.md:1`, `docs/examples/config/http-client-pool_idle_timeout/about.md:1`, `docs/examples/config/http-client-tls/about.md:1`, `docs/examples/config/http-client-proxy/about.md:1`, `docs/examples/config/io-temp_root/about.md:1`, `docs/examples/config/server/about.md:1`, `docs/examples/config/opcache-file_cache_dir/about.md:1`, `docs/examples/config/schedule/about.md:1`, `docs/examples/config/queue-max_attempts/about.md:1`.

backlog: The 46 tool sections with no description, under `docs/examples/tools/`: `bun nv proofs --gate` names each, and `bun nv proofs --id '<feature>'` prints what it owes and the path. They are the group after the rewrites (`docs/examples/README.md` § *The description*).
The 13 features of `tools:install` and `tools:server` owe a test, an example and an attack beside the description; goals `tools-install` and `tools-server` own them.

Some example comments still use the dense voice, for example "walk" and "giving up" in `docs/examples/core/Db-Connection/stream/` and `docs/examples/core/Db-Transaction/transaction/`. `bun nv proofs --comments` does not judge words; AGENTS.md § *Text an end user reads* owns the rule.
